KKR.title: KKR reopens Lending Partners shelf with $624 million static CLO
KKR.titleZh: KKR重启Lending Partners系列，发行6.24亿美元静态CLO
KKR.summary: KKR priced a $624 million static private-credit CLO under its Lending Partners shelf, according to Private Credit Daily citing Creditflux. The vehicle uses an existing fixed pool of loans and pays down as assets mature, rather than relying on a reinvestment period. For credit investors, the structure is relevant because it converts seasoned direct-lending exposure into rated term funding during a thinner origination market.
KKR.summaryZh: 据Private Credit Daily援引Creditflux报道，KKR在其Lending Partners系列下完成一笔6.24亿美元静态私募信贷CLO的定价。该产品采用既有的固定贷款资产池，随资产到期逐步偿还，而非依赖再投资期。对信贷投资者而言，该结构值得关注，因为它在新增放贷较为清淡的市场环境下，将已有一定存续期的直接贷款敞口转化为具评级的定期融资。

KKR.title: Apollo and KKR partner around Atlantic Aviation at a nearly $10 billion valuation
KKR.titleZh: Apollo与KKR携手合作Atlantic Aviation，估值近$10 billion
KKR.summary: Apollo-managed funds acquired a significant interest in Atlantic Aviation while KKR-managed funds remained a substantial shareholder, valuing the US aviation infrastructure platform at nearly $10 billion. The company operates fixed-base aviation infrastructure, including fueling, hangar leasing, and airport concession-backed services. Although this is an equity/infrastructure transaction, it is relevant to aircraft and aviation-linked collateral themes watched by private credit investors.
KKR.summaryZh: Apollo管理的基金收购了Atlantic Aviation的重大权益，KKR管理的基金仍为其主要股东，此次交易对这家美国航空基础设施平台的估值近$10 billion。该公司运营固定基地运营（FBO）航空基础设施，包括加油、机库租赁以及以机场特许经营权为支撑的服务。尽管这是一笔股权/基础设施交易，但与私募信贷投资者关注的飞机及航空相关抵押品主题相关。

Bain Capital.titleZh: Bain Capital Private Credit牵头为Playfly Sports提供2.5亿美元融资
Bain Capital.summary: Bain Capital's Private Credit Group acted as lead lender and administrative agent on a $250 million senior credit facility for Playfly Sports. The financing supports expansion at a sponsor-backed revenue platform with media, sponsorship, ticketing, and sports-technology exposure. The transaction is a fresh example of direct lending into a growth borrower outside the most heavily watched software-only names.
Bain Capital.summaryZh: Bain Capital旗下Private Credit Group担任牵头贷款人及行政代理人，为Playfly Sports提供2.5亿美元优先信贷融资。该笔融资用于支持这一由财务投资方支持的创收平台扩张，其业务涵盖媒体、赞助、票务及体育科技领域。该交易是直接贷款投向成长型借款人的又一新案例，且该借款人不属于最受关注的纯软件类企业。

PAG.title: Pagaya Issues AAA-Rated $600 Million Personal Loan ABS Transaction
PAG.titleZh: Pagaya发行6亿美元AAA级个人贷款ABS交易
PAG.summary: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Pagaya Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: PGY) (“Pagaya”), a global technology company delivering AI-driven product solutions for the financial ecosystem, today announced the closing of a $600 million AAA-rated personal loan ABS transaction (PAID 2026-6). “We achieved tighter pricing on this transaction relative to recent deals, which reflects strong investor confidence in Pagaya's credit performance and underwriting platform," said Sahil Chandiramani, Head of Capital Markets
PAG.summaryZh: 纽约--（美国商业资讯）--Pagaya Technologies Ltd.（NASDAQ: PGY）（“Pagaya”）是一家为金融生态系统提供AI驱动产品解决方案的全球科技公司，今日宣布完成一笔6亿美元AAA评级个人贷款ABS交易（PAID 2026-6）。资本市场主管Sahil Chandiramani表示：“与近期交易相比，本次交易的定价更为收窄，这反映出投资者对Pagaya信用表现及承销平台的强烈信心。”

(NASDAQ: PGY) (“Pagaya”), a global technology company delivering AI-driven product solutions for the financial ecosystem, today announced the closing of a $600 million AAA-rated personal loan ABS transaction (PAID 2026-6). “We achieved tighter pricing on this transaction relative to recent deals, which reflects strong investor confidence in Pagaya's credit performance and underwriting platform," said Sahil Chandiramani, Head of Capital Markets
items.articleExcerpt: Pagaya Issues AAA-Rated $600 Million Personal Loan ABS Transaction. NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Pagaya Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: PGY) (“Pagaya”), a global technology company delivering AI-driven product solutions for the financial ecosystem, today announced the closing of a $600 million AAA-rated personal loan ABS transaction (PAID 2026-6). “We achieved tighter pricing on this transaction relative to recent deals, which reflects strong investor confidence in Pagaya's credit performance and underwriting platform," said Sahil Chandiramani, Head of Capital Markets

Once by the software, and once by the auditor making sure the software got it right. If you can’t trust your AI QC platform to deliver a complete audit, we have one you can. Indecomm’s AuditGenius | ai automates the full audit. Every checklist question is evaluated against the agency, investor, and overlay requirements behind it, using logic our QC specialists approved before any loan runs. Each finding arrives with its severity and the page that supports it, and AuditGenius | ai’s Glassbox shows exactly how it was reached. Your auditors stay in control, confirming findings instead of redoing them. With AuditGenius | ai, our own prefunding QA review times dropped from up to 2 hours to about 15 minutes. One review instead of two. Revolutionary, we know. Request a demo of AuditGenius | ai.”
